item.title: Luxury Design Brands of the Rich and Famous
item.description: For most people, design brands such as Gucci, Chanel and Prada represent the height of style and fashion. The rich and famous, by contrast, prefer to buy brands that regular folks have never even heard of, such as Jada Dubai shoes, F.P. Journe wristwatches and Graff diamond jewellery.

item.title: The Last Decade’s Most Influential Designers
item.description: The period from 2010 to 2020 is primarily remembered as a high-point for designer clothing, characterized by the blending of streetwear and luxury fashion in never-before-seen ways. Among the most influential designers of this decade were such fashion heavyweights as Jun Takahashi, Hedi Slimane, and Raf Simons.

item.title: Stylish But Affordable Menswear Brands
item.description: You do not have to spend a fortune to wear trendy and high-quality designer clothing, especially when it comes to casual menswear. By way of example, men’s clothing brands that are reasonably priced, without sacrificing quality or style, include Asos White, Weekday, Arkos, Cos, and Oak+Fort.
